document: Candidate confirmation requires version checks, editable title and ignore reason.

requirements.title: Candidate confirmation requires version checks
requirements.description: Reviewer confirms only the candidate version currently displayed.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Confirm succeeds with the current version and fails with a stale version.

requirements.title: Ignoring a candidate requires a reason
requirements.description: Reviewer must provide an audit reason when ignoring a parsed requirement.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Ignore without reason is rejected; ignore with reason stores ignoredReason.

expected.title: Candidate confirmation requires version checks
Ignoring a candidate requires a reason

document: Webhook imports must validate timestamp, signature, idempotency key and event version.

requirements.title: Webhook validates HMAC signatures
requirements.description: Incoming CUSTOM_API events must use X-VA signature headers.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Invalid signatures are rejected and a rejected webhook event is recorded.

requirements.title: Webhook replay keeps idempotency
requirements.description: Repeated eventId or idempotencyKey with the same payload returns the existing import.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Same payload is idempotent; different payload returns conflict.

expected.title: Webhook validates HMAC signatures
Webhook replay keeps idempotency

document: Users upload Word, PDF and OCR image files. The platform must enforce binary size limits, parse text and require OCR configuration for scanned files.

requirements.title: Multipart document upload accepts real files
requirements.description: The import API accepts multipart/form-data with projectId, sourceType and file fields.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a valid docx file creates pending requirement candidates with sourceRef traceability.

requirements.title: OCR processing is bounded by runtime limits
requirements.description: OCR command execution must respect timeout, max output length and concurrent process limits.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: When the OCR command times out or the concurrency limit is reached, the import fails with a readable error and no secret or raw binary is logged.

requirements.title: Scanned PDF requires OCR provider
requirements.description: Image-only PDFs cannot be treated as text PDFs unless an OCR provider is configured.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A scanned PDF without OCR configuration returns validation failure and stores a failed import record.

expected.title: Multipart document upload accepts real files
OCR processing is bounded by runtime limits
Scanned PDF requires OCR provider

document: A Word requirement document describes review assignment and approval records.

requirements.title: Word import keeps reviewer assignment fields
requirements.description: Reviewer assignment parsed from Word documents should remain editable before confirmation.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A Word import creates a candidate with reviewer notes and confirmation can update the title before publish.

requirements.title: Word approval records remain traceable
requirements.description: Approval related paragraphs extracted from Word documents must keep sourceRef traceability.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Published WP3 requirements keep source, sourceRef and sourceUrl fields from the Word import.

expected.title: Word import keeps reviewer assignment fields
Word approval records remain traceable

document: A scanned ticket image describes invoice recognition and manual correction.

requirements.title: OCR scan import records low confidence candidates
requirements.description: Candidates extracted from image text should stay pending for manual review.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: OCR candidates are not auto-published and include parseSource plus source fragment context.

requirements.title: OCR correction updates candidate content before publish
requirements.description: Reviewers can fix recognition errors before confirming the parsed requirement.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Editing a candidate increments its version and stale confirmations are rejected.

expected.title: OCR scan import records low confidence candidates
OCR correction updates candidate content before publish

document: Webhook signing secrets can live in local encrypted storage or an external Vault/KMS provider. Fallback can be disabled in production.

requirements.title: Webhook secrets resolve through SecretProvider first
requirements.description: The resolver tries registered SecretProvider implementations before property fallback.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A provider value wins over a configured fallback value for the same secretRef.

requirements.title: External Vault and KMS providers use references only
requirements.description: The platform stores secretRef and provider metadata while plaintext is returned only by the external resolve endpoint.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Provider requests include purpose and scope context; responses and audit output never expose the resolved secret value.

requirements.title: Production can disable local webhook secret fallback
requirements.description: Operators can require all webhook secrets to resolve through SecretProvider.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: When fallback is disabled, unknown secret references are rejected before signature validation succeeds.

expected.title: Webhook secrets resolve through SecretProvider first
External Vault and KMS providers use references only
Production can disable local webhook secret fallback

document: Reviewers edit AI candidates, preview publish changes and publish confirmed requirements into WP3 assets.

requirements.title: Publish dry run returns create and update plans
requirements.description: The publish API must show what will be created, updated, skipped or conflicted before committing.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Dry run does not create WP3 assets and returns plannedCreateCount, plannedUpdateCount, conflictCount and record details.

requirements.title: Repeated external requirement ids update existing assets
requirements.description: Candidates with an existing externalRequirementId should link or update instead of creating duplicates.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Formal publish sets existingRequirementId for matched assets and keeps sourceRef and sourceUrl traceability.

requirements.title: Candidate review keeps optimistic locking
requirements.description: Edits and confirmations must include the version last displayed by the reviewer.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A stale version returns conflict and leaves the candidate unchanged.

expected.title: Publish dry run returns create and update plans
Repeated external requirement ids update existing assets
Candidate review keeps optimistic locking

document:
# Clearing center settlement
| Field | Rule | SLA |
| amount | must match ledger amount | T+0 |
| exceptionReason | mandatory for manual override | T+1 |
Priority aliases in the source mix P1/P3 with business terms.

requirements.title: Settlement table validates amount columns
requirements.description: Rows extracted from Markdown settlement tables must keep amount and ledger comparison semantics.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: When amount differs from ledger amount, the parsed candidate is marked HIGH priority and keeps the table source fragment.

requirements.title: Exception rows require reviewer notes
requirements.description: Manual override rows must require an operator reason before publishing to WP3.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Publishing is blocked when exceptionReason is empty; a non-empty reason is stored in acceptance criteria.

expected.title: Settlement table validates amount columns
Exception rows require reviewer notes

document: Retail mobile onboarding document with multiple sections: account creation, SMS verification, cart recovery, customer support attachment handling, fraud review notes and operational SLA paragraphs. The source is intentionally long and mixes product language with compliance hints.

requirements.title: Mobile signup handles rate limited verification codes
requirements.description: The app must throttle repeated SMS verification requests and explain retry windows.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: After the configured request limit is reached, a retry-after message is shown and no additional SMS provider call is made.

requirements.title: Dormant carts restore checkout context
requirements.description: Returning users should resume checkout with selected items, coupon state and delivery address draft.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A user returning within the retention window sees the same cart lines and coupon validation status.

requirements.title: Support agents can redact customer attachments
requirements.description: Customer service uploads may contain personal information and must be redacted before model parsing.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Attachment previews hide phone, email and address-like fields before they are sent to WP2 model parsing.

expected.title: Mobile signup handles rate limited verification codes
Dormant carts restore checkout context
Support agents can redact customer attachments

document: A healthcare Word document includes an approval matrix, department owner rows and patient identifier handling requirements.

requirements.title: Clinical approval matrix enforces department owners
requirements.description: Each imported clinical workflow requirement must keep the department owner and approval role from the matrix.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A requirement without department owner is kept pending and cannot be batch confirmed.

requirements.title: Patient identifiers are redacted before model parsing
requirements.description: Word paragraphs containing patient identifiers must be sanitized before WP2 invocation.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: The model request preview contains redacted placeholders and the raw identifier is absent from invocation logs.

expected.title: Clinical approval matrix enforces department owners
Patient identifiers are redacted before model parsing

document: A manufacturing PDF has rotated pages, repeated headers, broken bullets and numbered clauses copied from a supplier quality manual.

requirements.title: PDF parser keeps numbered clause titles from noisy pages
requirements.description: Broken page headers and footers must not replace clause titles in parsed candidates.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Candidates use the clause title as title and keep the noisy page text only as source fragment context.

requirements.title: Unreadable PDF pages surface partial import warnings
requirements.description: When only part of a PDF can be extracted, users need a warning before confirming candidates.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: The import is marked completed with warning and the warning is visible in import history with traceId.

expected.title: PDF parser keeps numbered clause titles from noisy pages
Unreadable PDF pages surface partial import warnings

document: A delivery proof photo contains low confidence OCR text, a partially recognized address and handwritten exception notes.

requirements.title: OCR delivery proof requires manual address review
requirements.description: Low confidence address fragments from delivery proof images must not be auto-published.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Candidates with lowConfidence address tags stay pending and display the image source reference for reviewer correction.

requirements.title: Handwritten delivery exceptions keep original trace
requirements.description: Handwritten exception notes should keep the original sourceRef for later dispute review.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Confirmed exception requirements include sourceRef, sourceUrl and reviewer correction history.

expected.title: OCR delivery proof requires manual address review
Handwritten delivery exceptions keep original trace
